title: Audit canonical Herdr plain-resume supervision
objective: Perform one final read-only, evidence-driven audit of the complete canonical Herdr plus plain codex resume supervisor implementation at the current worktree. Verify authority, session binding, exact wake delivery and cleanup, post-transport and lease fences, exactly-once behavior, busy and human-draft safety boundaries, detached dormancy, automatic terminal wake, pause-after-current ordering, recovery readiness, policy preservation, and all focused/full tests. Report any defect without modifying files.
scope: current repository source, tests, documentation, and git diff
current .opsle authoritative state, binding, wake requests, decisions, receipts, and compact packets
bound authoritative Codex rollout records needed for exact delivery and dormancy evidence
read-only process and tmux authority facts
relevant_context: The canonical transport must remain exact plain codex resume SESSION_ID MESSAGE, never codex exec resume or input injection.
Positive confirmation requires the unique exact wake message plus matching turn-began record in the bound rollout.
Temporary launcher and frontend groups must be empty while the original Herdr process continues.
The activation lease is 180 seconds, decision fences validate expiry, and any post-spawn uncertainty is non-replayable.
Detached ownership requires END_TURN_IMMEDIATELY and RUNNER_ONLY monitoring; the bound rollout must show no intervening supervisor turn/check before terminal wake.
The final launch uses atomic pause-after-current; completion must remain AWAITING_SUPERVISOR until this audit is accepted or rejected, and only then reach PAUSED.
Historical uncertain events remain immutable and must not be replayed.
acceptance_criteria: exactly one authoritative supervisor exists on Herdr and the old tmux authority is absent
the session binding is valid for repository, supervisor identity, generation, Herdr process, session UUID, and bound rollout
the canonical message and argv are exact and contain no raw child output

delivery confirmation, temporary frontend cleanup, Herdr continuity, generation/event fencing, stale-dispatcher rejection, expiry fencing, uncertainty handling, and duplicate suppression are deterministic
live receipts prove automatic plain-resume delivery and zero duplicate frontend
detached live rollout evidence proves prompt idle with zero intervening supervisor checks or turns until terminal wake
busy behavior retries only after deterministic bound-rollout state change and never model-polls
transport never calls tmux input or Herdr input and therefore never mutates a human draft
pause-after-current is armed atomically, leaves completion AWAITING_SUPERVISOR, records evaluation first, then applies PAUSED and blocks the next child
Codex enabled, Claude disabled, review off, Gearbox required, Context Firewall required, and model polling prohibited remain unchanged
Context Firewall packet is complete_for_decision with no unresolved defect
expected_deliverable: A compact PASS or FAIL audit identifying exact durable evidence and any residual limitation, with no repository modifications.
expected_evidence: representative delivered, uncertain, duplicate, busy, dormancy, and pause-order evidence

may: read repository, .opsle durable state, the bound rollout, and exact process/tmux facts
run read-only focused and full local verification
may_not: consume or replay events, evaluate tasks, signal runtime, invoke live wake, or send terminal input
change policy, identity, binding, objective, pause, generation, host configuration, or git state
modify siblings, push, merge, deploy, install, or initialize a repository
